name: 8 oz Center-Cut Filet Mignon with Plain Baked Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's at Bear Lake West (Fish Haven, ID)
whyItWorks: Center-cut beef tenderloin is the leanest, most tender cut of beef with minimal gristle or connective tissue. Paired with a soft baked Idaho potato (without rough skin), it provides premium nutrient-dense recovery fuel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for filet prepared medium-rare or medium without heavy black pepper crust. Scoop out the fluffy interior of the baked potato and top with a small pat of butter.
